items.title: Rahul Gandhi meets Tamil Nadu CM Vijay in Chennai, allies head for coffee and tiramisu after political talks
items.excerpt: Rahul Gandhi and Vijay visited Bask by Coffee, a cafe, and reportedly had a cappuccino, tiramisu, and cookies.
